issues.spec_citation: CQL 1.5.3 Logical Specification §DateTime operator; Author's Guide Table 2-K / DateTime timezone offset; Appendix B DateTime lexical offset format
issues.evidence: Archived in ARCHIVE_LOG.md: CQL-03 HISTORIAN DateTime Constructor Timezone Remediation - 2026-05-30.
issues.root_cause: The CQL DateTime constructor literal fast path formatted timezoneOffset by splitting decimal hours into integer hours plus rounded fractional minutes without carrying minute=60, and accepted Boolean/non-numeric SQLLiteral offsets through Python bool-as-int or silent omission.
issues.resolution: Updated DateTime constructor lowering to validate static timezoneOffset as Decimal, reject non-Decimal/boolean literals, round total absolute minutes with hour carry, enforce +/-14:00, and apply the same total-minute/range logic to the runtime timezone path.
